fields.name: visits_done
fields.description: Number of completed 'move to the top of the target' subgoals so far in the episode, counting each arrival of the held cube over a target (right or left). It is 0 at the first step and stays 0 through the step that ends the pick-up. It increases by exactly 1 at each decision step that ends a B subgoal, i.e. the step whose final frame shows the cube held in the gripper above a highlighted target that was not highlighted at the first execution frame of that step. It does not change at the step that ends the put-down (cube no longer held) or at the press-button step. e.g. 3
